title: 5 Civilization Font
description: This resource pack includes the font for Five Civilization, but because it's so awesome it can be used for any world as a spice to fonts.
body:
This font is used in combonation with the 5 Civilization reaource pack, but can also be used for you own worlds.  

This font includes custom upper and lower case of the English latin alphabet only.  

This font was made from scratch and all letter contain a square, making a distinct font.
